correctness.rationale: Summing the 2^n independent signed orientations over every permutation gives an integer permanent with entries 2/-1; expansion in selected zero cells gives the stated rook polynomial. For n=3^a-b, b in {1,2}, the valuation of the k-rook term exceeds the 0-rook factorial valuation for every k>=1, so no nonzero character can cancel the leading term. For n=4,5 the same conclusion follows modulo 9. The 512 rank-three zero boards and 65,536 rank-four boards are exhaustively checked in exact integers by independently computed rook recurrences and permutation permanents. Rank three also independently enumerates all 19,683 ternary characters. Null-board orbit sizes and weighted multiplicities are verified by attached program; no finite test is used as proof of the infinite family.
